ver: Artifact-level version counter. Not used by dep-graph — field versions are tracked separately in project.json via set_json_tracked(). May be incremented manually if needed.
meta.title: Official application name confirmed in the interview.
meta.updated_at: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last write.
overview: 1–2 sentences — what the app does and for whom. Should be understandable by a non-technical reader.
problem_statement: The pain, gap, or inefficiency this app solves. Why does it need to exist?
goals: List of outcomes the app must achieve. Each entry: { item: what to achieve, reason: why it matters }.
non_goals: What will NOT be built in this version. Explicit non-goals prevent scope creep. Each entry: { item: what is excluded, reason: why it is excluded }.
initial_actors: Who interacts with the system. Plain strings — e.g. ['Admin', 'Customer', 'Driver']. Refined into actor-index.json in Phase 2.
assumptions: Things believed to be true but not yet confirmed. Each entry: { assumption: the belief, status: 'confirmed' | 'tbd' }.
constraints: Hard limits the solution must operate within. Each entry: { type: 'business' | 'technical' | 'time' | 'budget', description: the constraint }.
success_metrics: How we know the app succeeded. Plain strings — e.g. ['95% uptime', '< 2s page load', '1000 active users in month 1'].
